Hakujuji Co., Ltd..note: Hakujuji Co., Ltd. is an independent manufacturer and distributor of healthcare and medical instruments founded in 1896.

KMS Medisurgi Limited.note: KMS Medisurgi Limited operates as an independent, publicly listed company in India producing coated adhesive substrates.

Medicare Hygiene Limited.note: Medicare Hygiene Limited operates as an independent manufacturer and exporter of wound care dressings since 1994.

Nano Fanavaran Narin Teb.note: Nano Fanavaran Narin Teb operates as an independent knowledge-based nanotechnology firm in Iran.

PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk.note: PT Jayamas Medica Industri Tbk trades publicly under the OneMed brand and operates as a subsidiary of Pt. Intisumber Hasilsempurna.

Sanomedical Asiapac Sdn. Bhd..note: Sanomedical Asiapac Sdn. Bhd. operates as a wholly owned manufacturing subsidiary established by SM Health Care Sdn. Bhd.

Tasami Medical.note: Tasami Medical is an independent Saudi-based medical dressing manufacturer founded by Anas Agha and has no record of being acquired.
